title: Apply checklist for vendor data access
requirement: Apply this checklist when a vendor stores, transmits, or otherwise accesses company or customer information and record the intended use, data categories, evidence sources, and review date.

policy_evidence.text: Apply this checklist when a vendor stores, transmits, or otherwise accesses company or customer information. Record the intended use, data categories, evidence sources, and review date.

title: Human analyst review required
requirement: A Northstar analyst must review evidence and citations before a final decision; AI‑generated findings are drafts.

policy_evidence.text: Human review required. AI-generated findings are drafts. A Northstar analyst owns the assessment and must review evidence and citations before a final decision.

title: Do not treat missing evidence as compliance
requirement: Missing evidence must never be treated as proof of compliance.

policy_evidence.text: Missing evidence must never be treated as proof of compliance.

title: Escalate conflicting claims
requirement: Escalate conflicting claims and request clarification rather than choosing one silently.

policy_evidence.text: Escalate conflicting claims and request clarification rather than choosing one silently.

title: Data encryption at rest and in transit
requirement: Company data is encrypted at rest and in transit.

policy_evidence.text:
SEC-01
Company data is encrypted at rest and in transit.

title: Privileged and production access MFA
requirement: Privileged and production access uses multi‑factor authentication (MFA).

policy_evidence.text:
SEC-02
Privileged and production access uses MFA.

title: Quarterly customer data access review
requirement: Access to customer data is reviewed at least quarterly.

policy_evidence.text:
SEC-03
Access to customer data is reviewed at least
quarterly.

title: Security event logging and monitoring
requirement: Security events are logged and monitored.

policy_evidence.text:
SEC-04
Security events are logged and monitored.

title: Critical vulnerability remediation timeframe
requirement: Critical vulnerabilities are remediated within 15 calendar days.

policy_evidence.text:
VULN-01
Critical vulnerabilities are remediated within 15
calendar days.

title: Incident notification window
requirement: Northstar is notified of a confirmed incident affecting its data within 72 hours of discovery.

policy_evidence.text:
IR-01
Northstar is notified of a confirmed incident affecting
its data within 72 hours of discovery.

title: Subprocessor identification and communication
requirement: All subprocessors handling Northstar data are identified and changes are communicated.

policy_evidence.text:
PRIV-01
All subprocessors handling Northstar data are
identified and changes are communicated.

title: Data deletion after termination
requirement: Northstar data is deleted within 30 days after service termination, unless legally required otherwise.

policy_evidence.text:
DATA-01
Northstar data is deleted within 30 days after service
termination, unless legally required otherwise.

title: Business continuity documentation
requirement: Documented continuity and recovery arrangements cover the service, including test cadence, recovery objectives, and scope.

policy_evidence.text:
BCP-01
Documented continuity and recovery arrangements
cover the service.

title: AI model training restriction
requirement: Northstar data is not used to train shared models without written authorization.

policy_evidence.text:
AI-01
Northstar data is not used to train shared models
without written authorization.

title: Unmet high‑severity control escalation
requirement: Any Unmet High control requires security owner review.

policy_evidence.text: Any Unmet High control requires security owner review.

title: Unclear high‑severity control escalation
requirement: Any Unclear High control requires vendor follow‑up before a final risk decision.

policy_evidence.text: Any Unclear High control requires vendor follow-up before a final risk decision.

title: Contradictory evidence handling
requirement: Contradictory evidence must be marked Unclear until reconciled.

policy_evidence.text: Contradictory evidence must be marked Unclear until reconciled.

title: Exception documentation procedure
requirement: Analysts may document an approved exception with an owner, rationale, and expiry date.

policy_evidence.text: Analysts may document an approved exception with an owner, rationale, and expiry date.

title: Final decision record preservation
requirement: Preserve the final decision record with reviewed statuses, citations, analyst notes, exceptions, reviewer identity, and decision date.

policy_evidence.text: Final decision record: preserve the reviewed statuses, citations, analyst notes, exceptions, reviewer identity, and decision date.
